title: Write a professional brief
description: Produce a concise formal brief with clear staging and emphasis.

items.prompt: Write a professional brief (6–8 sentences) outlining a recommendation and its implications.
items.promptIt: Scrivi un brief professionale (6–8 frasi) delineando una raccomandazione e le sue implicazioni.

items.prompt: Rewrite one informal sentence into formal correspondence style.
items.promptIt: Riscrivi una frase informale in stile di corrispondenza formale.
hints: Can you confirm ASAP? → I should be grateful if you could confirm...
